title: Wolfram Language and Mathematica version 15
summary: Stephen Wolfram announces the release of Wolfram Language and Mathematica version 15, featuring integrated AI capabilities and extensive new core functionality for computational mathematics and symbolic computation.
problem_solved: Provides enhanced computational capabilities with built-in AI features for mathematical modeling, data analysis, and automated reasoning tasks.
why_valuable: Version 15 brings native AI integration directly into the Wolfram computational environment, enabling seamless AI-assisted computation without external dependencies.
